headlines.headline: Best Buy Observes Consumer Shift Toward Value and Premium Upgrades
headlines.summary: Best Buy reports that shoppers are balancing a focus on value with a willingness to upgrade to premium price points during the holiday season.

headlines.headline: Daiwa Adjusts Price Target on Walmart to $140 From $113
headlines.summary: Daiwa Securities has updated its price target for Walmart Inc. shares, increasing the target from $113 to $140.

headlines.headline: Moody's Upgrades Vietnam's Sovereign Credit Rating to Ba1
headlines.summary: Moody's Ratings has upgraded Vietnam's sovereign credit rating from Ba2 to Ba1, citing improvements in governance and economic diversification.

headlines.headline: Wedbush Initiates Coverage of ExlService Holdings, Inc. with Outperform Rating
headlines.summary: Wedbush has initiated coverage on ExlService Holdings, Inc. with an 'Outperform' rating and a price target of $50.

headlines.headline: Garmin Hosts 2026 Wearable Technology Exhibition
headlines.summary: Garmin held an exhibition in 2026 focused on showcasing its wearable technology through interactive sports experiences.

headlines.headline: Moody's Maintains NVIDIA's Aa1 Rating and Stable Outlook
headlines.summary: Moody's confirmed that NVIDIA's Aa1 credit rating and stable outlook remain unchanged, distinguishing its assessment from recent concerns raised by other agencies regarding corporate governance.

headlines.headline: Moody's Affirms A3 Credit Rating for Amplius
headlines.summary: Moody's has published an updated credit opinion for the housing association Amplius, affirming its A3 stable credit rating.

headlines.headline: DPC Dash Expands Domino's Pizza China Supply Chain Network
headlines.summary: DPC Dash, the master franchisee for Domino's Pizza in China, has scaled its supply chain infrastructure with a new facility in Wuhan to support ongoing store expansion.

headlines.headline: Apple Removes Talkie AI App from App Store Worldwide
headlines.summary: Apple has removed the Talkie AI chatbot app from its App Store globally, citing concerns regarding child safety.

headlines.headline: Apple to Open New Retail Store in Hyderabad, India
headlines.summary: Apple is set to expand its retail footprint in India with the opening of a new store in Hyderabad on December 10, 2026.

headlines.headline: Adobe Acrobat Recognized as Top AI Document Assistant for Business Teams
headlines.summary: Adobe Acrobat has been highlighted by Expert Consumers for its capabilities in PDF editing, summarization, and document productivity.

headlines.headline: Walmart Integrates Meta's Muse AI for Shopping
headlines.summary: Walmart has integrated Meta's Muse platform to enable AI-assisted shopping, allowing consumers to search for products and complete purchases through AI agents.

headlines.headline: Moody's Ratings Introduces New 'XG' Issuer Rating Category
headlines.summary: Moody's Ratings has launched a new rating category called the 'XG Issuer Rating' and assigned its first rating of this type to Coop Pank.

headlines.headline: VeriSign Insider Executes Share Sale
headlines.summary: A VeriSign insider has sold shares of the company's common stock valued at approximately $1.04 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

headlines.headline: Best Buy Announces Regular Quarterly Cash Dividend
headlines.summary: Best Buy Co., Inc. has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.96 per common share, payable in early 2027.

headlines.headline: Dropbox to Present at the 2026 UBS Global Technology and AI Conference
headlines.summary: Dropbox, Inc. announced that its Chief Financial Officer, Ross Tennenbaum, will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 UBS Global Technology and AI Conference.

headlines.headline: Berri Organics Launches Electrolyte Drinks at Kroger Banners
headlines.summary: Berri Organics has announced that its Berri Lyte electrolyte drinks are now available at Kroger's King Soopers and Fred Meyer retail locations.

headlines.headline: Winmark Insider Sells Shares Worth $411,525
headlines.summary: A Winmark Corporation insider has sold company shares valued at $411,525, according to a recent SEC filing.

headlines.headline: Doba Launches Seller Recruitment Campaign for Walmart Marketplace
headlines.summary: Doba, an approved Walmart Solution Provider, has initiated a campaign to recruit online retailers to sell on the Walmart Marketplace.

headlines.headline: EXL Named a Leader in 2026 ISG Provider Lens Generative AI and Agentic AI Services Global Reports
headlines.summary: EXL has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 ISG Provider Lens Generative AI Services Global report and advanced to a Leader position in the Agentic AI Development and Deployment Services report.

headlines.headline: Ralph Lauren Opens First Global Home-Dedicated Boutique in Milan
headlines.summary: Ralph Lauren Corporation has inaugurated its first boutique worldwide exclusively focused on its home collection, located in Milan's historic Quadrilatero district.

headlines.headline: BNP Paribas Adjusts Clorox Price Target to $109 From $98
headlines.summary: BNP Paribas has updated its price target for The Clorox Company, raising it to $109 from the previous level of $98.

headlines.headline: Metalsource Mining Inc. Issues Correction Notice
headlines.summary: Metalsource Mining Inc. issued a correction notice regarding its news release disseminated on November 24, 2026.

headlines.headline: Metalsource Mining Inc. Reports Assay Results from Silver Hill Drill Program
headlines.summary: Metalsource Mining Inc. announced new assay results from its ongoing drill program at the Silver Hill project, highlighting significant polymetallic mineralization.

headlines.headline: Sally Beauty CEO Denise Paulonis Executes Insider Stock Transaction
headlines.summary: Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc. CEO Denise Paulonis engaged in an insider stock transaction on November 23, 2026, at an average price of $18 per share.

headlines.headline: Berenberg Adjusts Balfour Beatty Estimates and Price Target Following Updated FY26 Guidance
headlines.summary: Berenberg has revised its financial estimates and price target for Balfour Beatty following the company's updated guidance for the 2026 fiscal year.

headlines.headline: Citigroup and D.A. Davidson Adjust Price Targets on Autodesk
headlines.summary: Financial analysts at Citigroup and D.A. Davidson have updated their price targets for Autodesk, Inc. following the company's fiscal third-quarter earnings report.

headlines.headline: Guardian Pharmacy Services Joins S&P SmallCap 600
headlines.summary: Guardian Pharmacy Services has been added to the S&P SmallCap 600 index, with the company's stock reaching an all-time high.

headlines.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Best Buy Following Recent Performance
headlines.summary: Multiple financial institutions, including Wedbush, Truist, and Jefferies, have updated their price targets for Best Buy Co., Inc. on November 25, 2026.

headlines.headline: Walmart-Backed PhonePe Resumes IPO Process
headlines.summary: PhonePe, a fintech company backed by Walmart, has restarted its IPO process with a target valuation of up to $15 billion.

headlines.headline: UL Solutions Participates in AmCham Korea AI Roundtable
headlines.summary: Representatives from UL Solutions attended a closed-door roundtable hosted by the American Chamber of Commerce in Korea to discuss AI infrastructure and international standards.

headlines.headline: William O'Neil Initiates Coverage on Walmart with Buy Rating
headlines.summary: Investment firm William O'Neil has initiated coverage on Walmart Inc. with a 'Buy' rating.

headlines.headline: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to Step Down
headlines.summary: Kalyan Krishnamurthy, the Chief Executive Officer of Walmart-owned e-commerce platform Flipkart, is stepping down from his position.

headlines.headline: Moody's Maintains Stable Outlook for EU and UK Credit Ratings
headlines.summary: Moody's Ratings has issued a report indicating a stable outlook for the credit fundamentals of the European Union and the United Kingdom.

headlines.headline: Apple Participates in Korea-US AI Infrastructure Roundtable
headlines.summary: Apple representatives joined a closed-door roundtable in Seoul to discuss expanding AI infrastructure and accelerating AI adoption in manufacturing.

headlines.headline: VA SkyWire Expands MDU Footprint Using Calix SmartMDU
headlines.summary: VA SkyWire is scaling its multi-dwelling unit (MDU) operations and expanding into new markets by leveraging the Calix SmartMDU solution on the Calix One platform.

headlines.headline: Exelixis to Participate in the Citi 2026 Global Healthcare Conference
headlines.summary: Exelixis, Inc. announced that its management team will participate in a fireside chat at the upcoming Citi 2026 Global Healthcare Conference.

headlines.headline: Walmart Launches 'Muse' AI Shopping Assistant
headlines.summary: Walmart has introduced a new AI-powered shopping assistant called Muse, designed to streamline product discovery and purchasing through the Walmart Agent Gateway.

headlines.headline: Symbotic Announces $7 Billion Expansion of Walmart Automation Agreement
headlines.summary: Symbotic Inc. has disclosed an expanded agreement with Walmart Inc. that includes approximately $7 billion in additional work and a potential automation rollout across 400 stores.

headlines.headline: Dorman Products Achieves Significant Gains in AI-Driven Forecasting
headlines.summary: Dorman Products has successfully implemented AI forecasting to manage its complex portfolio of over 100,000 SKUs, resulting in improved accuracy and operational efficiency.

headlines.headline: Apple to Host Special Event at SoHo Store Marking 20 Years of (RED) Partnership
headlines.summary: Apple announced a special event at its SoHo retail location in New York City to commemorate the 20th anniversary of its collaboration with the (RED) organization.

headlines.headline: Cheniere Energy Named Platinum Sponsor for 26th World LNG Summit & Awards
headlines.summary: Cheniere Energy is participating as a platinum sponsor for the upcoming 26th World LNG Summit & Awards, scheduled to take place in Istanbul from December 1–4, 2026.

headlines.headline: Moody's Launches Zero-Copy Data Exchange for AI Platforms
headlines.summary: Moody's has introduced a new zero-copy data exchange capability designed to integrate its financial intelligence directly into customer AI platforms.

headlines.headline: J.P. Morgan Maintains Buy Rating and $355 Price Target for Apple
headlines.summary: J.P. Morgan analyst Samik Chatterjee has reaffirmed a Buy rating and a $355 price target for Apple Inc. (AAPL).
